vmrbooklet.help.open: /vbooklet - open this screen (or press B; B or Esc closes it)
vmrbooklet.help.upload_link: /upload <google-sheet-link> - track progress from your own sheet's "Obtained" column
vmrbooklet.help.upload: /upload - re-sync using whichever link you last used
vmrbooklet.help.export: /export - same as /upload: re-sync from your remembered sheet
vmrbooklet.help.undo: /vbooklet undo - revert the last /upload or /vbooklet restore
vmrbooklet.help.backup: /vbooklet backup - copy a code of YOUR progress (no Sheets needed)
vmrbooklet.help.restore: /vbooklet restore [code] - restore your progress from a backup code (no code = read the clipboard)
vmrbooklet.help.export_booklet: /export booklet - copy a code of your progress to share with a friend
vmrbooklet.help.import: /import [code] - add a friend's code as a read-only tab above the list (no code = read the clipboard)
vmrbooklet.help.export_csv: /vbooklet export-csv - write your full progress to a local CSV file
vmrbooklet.help.unknown: /vbooklet unknown - list booklet items this mod doesn't recognize yet (page through /booklet first)
vmrbooklet.help.missing: /vbooklet missing - copy a list of everything you haven't obtained yet to the clipboard
vmrbooklet.help.missing_bycategory: /vbooklet missing bycategory - same, grouped under a header line per category
vmrbooklet.help.missing_notes: /vbooklet missing notes - same, but with each item's acquisition note attached
vmrbooklet.help.trades: /vbooklet trades - copy a list of your missing items that an imported friend already has
vmrbooklet.help.need: /vbooklet need <item> - copy a list of raw materials you still need to craft that item
vmrbooklet.help.goal_item: /vbooklet goal <item> - pin/unpin an item on your current goal list (shown as a header progress line)
vmrbooklet.help.goal: /vbooklet goal - list your current goal list's items and progress; /vbooklet goal clear empties it
vmrbooklet.help.goal_lists: /vbooklet goal lists - list every named goal list; /vbooklet goal list <name> switches to or creates one
vmrbooklet.help.goal_delete: /vbooklet goal delete <name> - delete a named goal list (the default list can only be cleared)
vmrbooklet.help.ready: /vbooklet ready - list items in your inventory you still need, and which you can finish right now
vmrbooklet.help.note: /vbooklet note <item> <text|here|clear> - your own note or saved location for an item (shown in its detail panel)
vmrbooklet.help.card: /vbooklet card - save a shareable PNG progress card (click the file name in chat to open it)
vmrbooklet.help.reload: /vbooklet reload - re-read the item list (config/vmrbooklet/items.json replaces the bundled list if present)
vmrbooklet.help.keys: B toggles this screen; / or Ctrl+F focuses search; H/S/R/T/N/F toggle the overlays; Esc closes an overlay, then the screen
vmrbooklet.help.search_syntax: Search: @category, #release, !done / !todo / !partial / !new, >50%% or <50%%, plus any words from the name
vmrbooklet.help.hover_lookup: In any inventory or chest, hover an item and press B to open the booklet on it
vmrbooklet.help.favorite: Click the star on an item to favorite it, or right-click a row to favorite it directly
vmrbooklet.help.show_filter: Show: left-click cycles the filter, right-click opens a dropdown to jump straight to one
vmrbooklet.help.category_filter: Category: left-click cycles categories, right-click opens a dropdown to jump straight to one
vmrbooklet.help.button_stats: The %% button shows completion by release and a leaderboard vs your imported friends
vmrbooklet.help.button_recent: The R button shows items you've recently completed
vmrbooklet.help.button_timeline: The T button shows a day-by-day timeline of how many items you've completed
vmrbooklet.help.button_needed: The N button shows what's still needed to craft the selected item, as an expandable tree
vmrbooklet.help.button_friends: The F button (with friends imported) shows who already has each of your missing items
vmrbooklet.help.arrows: Up/Down arrows move the list selection, Enter jumps to the first result
vmrbooklet.help.paging: Page Up/Page Down jump a full panel of items, Home/End jump to the top/bottom of the list
vmrbooklet.help.letter_rail: Click a letter on the right edge of the list to jump to it
vmrbooklet.help.ingredient_filter: Click a recipe's ingredient to filter the list to everything else that uses it
vmrbooklet.help.back: The < button (once you've followed a link) goes back to what you were looking at before
vmrbooklet.help.milestones: You'll get a toast at 25/50/75/100%% overall booklet completion, once each
vmrbooklet.help.live_scan: Opening the real server /booklet and paging through it also tracks progress automatically
